children: Chain Bridge Bancorp’s revenue and earnings rose year over year, as higher average interest-bearing deposits and investment securities lifted net interest income and stronger deposit placement services boosted noninterest income. Higher taxes, operating expenses and credit-loss provisions partly offset the gains.
² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per common share, basic and diluted”.
: Increased 61.8% year over year; net interest margin rose to 3.53% from 3.35%.
: Income rose to $2.0M, principally reflecting higher average One-Way Sell balances; these totaled $498.5M at quarter-end.
: Income increased 38.3%; assets under administration reached $732.6M, up from $552.4M a year earlier.
: Commercial loans grew $26.7M from December 31, 2025, primarily as political organization borrowers drew on lines ahead of the federal election.
: No nonaccrual loans, loans 90 days or more past due, or other real estate owned at September 30, 2026.
